facts.fact: Starlink received a 12-month provisional licence to provide fixed high-speed satellite internet across Côte d'Ivoire; no licence date is given, so the article date is used, and launch was planned for July 2026.
Orange Côte d'Ivoire launched the satellite broadband service Orange Sat with Eutelsat in January 2026, aimed at underserved areas.

note: MTN-Eutelsat Konnect agreement of April 2026 is a capacity agreement, not recorded as a fact.
